description.value: Deerview Lodge & Cabins is a family-run property on the Crowsnest Highway in Princeton, BC, offering rooms, suites, and pet-friendly cabins with fully equipped kitchens in every unit. With over 10 years serving Princeton, the lodge primarily caters to industrial crews and contractors at nearby mine and mill projects. Touring cyclists passing through on the Crowsnest route would find a functional overnight stop with full kitchen access and Wi-Fi, though the property's services and marketing are firmly oriented toward workforce accommodation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is available and consistently identifies the business as 'Deerview Lodge & Cabins' (not 'Deerview Motel' as in OSM), a workforce/crew housing property targeting mine and mill contractors in Princeton, BC. The website confirms the phone number (250-295-0106) and explicitly mentions fast, reliable Wi-Fi, but contains no mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or any cycling-specific amenities. The property's entire marketing is oriented toward industrial crews, not recreational tourists.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Deerview Motel' but the website consistently uses 'Deerview Lodge & Cabins' across all pages — OSM name appears outdated.
Email discrepancy: OSM lists deerviewlodgeprinceton@gmail.com but the website shows stay@deerviewlodge.com.
Property is marketed exclusively toward industrial crew and contractor accommodation; no evidence of cycling-friendly services, bike storage, or appeal to recreational touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The property is a legitimate accommodation on the Crowsnest Highway cycling corridor, but it is explicitly and entirely marketed as industrial workforce housing with no mention of cycling amenities, bike storage, or recreational travelers. Insufficient evidence to confirm it meets any required WWC criteria.
